title: Task-report scope splits by drive-letter casing on Windows: hook and MCP server disagree, hunch_task returns task not found
observation: Observed 2026-09-14 on Windows 11. scopeOf(root) in src/core/taskReport.ts and promptTaskId/nativeHookCwd in src/core/taskReportHook.ts hashed fs.realpathSync(root), which on Windows preserves the caller's drive-letter casing, while realpathSync.native returns canonical on-disk casing. The host spawned the prompt hook with an uppercase-drive cwd and the MCP server with a lowercase-drive cwd, so tasks were opened under one scope hash and looked up under another (8 vs 6 tasks in .hunch-cache/served.db for one repository). Passing cwd to hunch_task did not help because the MCP re-root check compares canonicalRootPath (native) and concluded the roots were equal. Result: hunch_task start/finish failed with 'task not found in this repository/worktree' for 3 of 4 prompts in one session, and hunch task list / the Contribution view / hunch task status each saw half the ledger. RESOLVED in 9d16f8d (branch feat/task-records): canonicalReportRoot (realpathSync.native, fallback realpathSync) in src/core/taskReportPaths.ts is used by scopeOf, promptTaskId, nativeHookCwd, createTaskReporter and reportSourceSnapshot; ledger queries accept a legacy scope pair (caller casing and the drive-letter-swapped spelling) so rows from earlier releases stay readable until they expire. Regression test: test/task-record.test.ts 'task scope survives drive-letter casing differences'. Still open outside the product: this dev checkout registers the prompt hook twice (.claude/settings.json via tsx src and .claude/settings.local.json via a stale dist build), which duplicates the UserPromptSubmit notice.
evidence: realpath probe: realpathSync keeps the caller's drive-letter case; realpathSync.native returns the on-disk case
